recent_events.title: CTV and Noovo standalone apps and websites sunset, content moves exclusively to Crave
recent_events.description: Bell Media decommissioned the standalone CTV and Noovo apps and streaming on ctv.ca, consolidating all on-demand content onto the Crave platform. Free streaming access to CTV content remains available through Crave with a Bell Media account.
recent_events.impact: Major platform consolidation marking Bell Media's shift to a unified streaming-first digital strategy

recent_events.title: Crave original 'Heated Rivalry' becomes one of Canada's biggest-ever streaming hits
recent_events.description: The Canadian hockey romance series 'Heated Rivalry' drove a marked increase in Crave subscriptions, with Bell Media President Sean Cohan calling it potentially the biggest hit out of Canada ever. The success validated Bell's investment in original Canadian content.
recent_events.impact: Demonstrated commercial viability of Canadian original programming on streaming platforms

recent_events.title: Crave unveils major expansion with live CTV/Noovo programming and 10,000+ hours of new content
recent_events.description: Bell Media launched a significantly transformed Crave streaming service adding over 10,000 hours of content including live programming from CTV and Noovo, news, select sports, and expanded kids programming. The platform grew from 30,000 to 40,000+ hours of content.
recent_events.impact: Largest content expansion in Crave history, positioning it as a comprehensive streaming hub

recent_events.title: Bell Media closes strategic investment in Blink49 Studios
recent_events.description: Bell Media completed its strategic investment in independent production company Blink49 Studios (Toronto, Vancouver, Los Angeles), establishing a production and global distribution partnership. Blink49 is known for producing 'Beast Games' and other content.
recent_events.impact: Strengthens Bell Media's content production pipeline and international distribution capabilities

recent_events.title: Bell Media and Tubi announce strategic ad sales and distribution partnership
recent_events.description: Bell Media partnered with Fox-owned free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) service Tubi to co-develop programming and handle Canadian advertising sales. Bell Media's FAST channels were added to Tubi's live TV catalogue in Canada.
recent_events.impact: Expands Bell Media's FAST channel reach and monetization through partnership with a major global streaming platform

recent_events.title: Bell Media announces Crave revamp with free streaming tier and 30% more content
recent_events.description: Bell Media unveiled plans for an enhanced Crave platform with over 30% more content, a redesigned user experience, and both paid and free options. The new version includes content from HBO, Max Originals, CTV, Noovo, and Bell Media specialty channels.
recent_events.impact: Introduction of free tier significantly lowers barrier to entry and expands addressable audience

recent_events.title: Bell Media acquires majority stake in global content distributor Sphere Abacus
recent_events.description: Bell Media acquired a majority stake in Sphere Abacus, the international distribution arm of Montreal-based Sphere Media. Sphere Abacus becomes the primary international distributor of Bell Media's programming catalogue, launching the 'Northern Lights' initiative for global production partnerships.
recent_events.impact: Major step in exporting Canadian content globally and participating in the international content distribution value chain

recent_events.title: Bell Media closes C$410 million acquisition of Outfront Media Canada
recent_events.description: Bell Media finalized the acquisition of Outfront Media's Canadian business for C$410 million, merging it into its Astral outdoor advertising division. The deal added 9,325 digital and static advertising displays across Canada.
recent_events.impact: Solidified Bell Media's leadership in Canadian out-of-home advertising market

recent_events.title: BCE announces 4,800 job cuts including 10% from Bell Media, sells 45 radio stations
recent_events.description: BCE announced sweeping layoffs of 4,800 positions across its operations, with approximately 10% from Bell Media. The company cut most noon and weekend CTV newscasts, reduced CTV News Channel and BNN Bloomberg programming, and sold 45 of its 103 radio stations to multiple buyers.
recent_events.impact: Significant restructuring reflecting challenges in traditional media; marked strategic retreat from radio and local news

recent_events.title: Sean Cohan appointed as new President of Bell Media
recent_events.description: BCE named Sean Cohan, a former A&E Networks and Nielsen executive, as the new president of Bell Media, replacing the retiring Wade Oosterman. Cohan was tasked with transforming Canada's largest legacy media company into a modern digital powerhouse.
recent_events.impact: Leadership change signaling strategic pivot toward digital transformation and international content expansion

core_business: 贝尔传媒（Bell Media）是加拿大最大的私营大众媒体集团，为加拿大最大电信公司BCE Inc.（贝尔加拿大企业）的全资子公司。公司总部位于多伦多皇后西街299号，拥有5000余名员工。贝尔传媒的核心业务涵盖五大板块：一是电视广播，运营加拿大历史最悠久、收视最高的私营英语电视网CTV（含22间直属分台）、次要电视系统CTV第二台（7间分台）以及魁北克省法语电视网Noovo（5间分台）；二是专业电视频道，拥有27个英语和12个法语专业频道，涵盖体育（TSN/RDS，与ESPN联营）、新闻（BNN Bloomberg、CP24、CTV News Channel）、娱乐（CTV Drama/Comedy/Sci-Fi等）及特级付费频道（Crave、HBO加拿大版、Starz）；三是流媒体平台Crave，为加拿大最大的本土流媒体服务，提供HBO/Max原创剧集、Crave原创内容、CTV/Noovo直播节目及超过4万小时内容库，并于2025-2026年完成重大升级，引入免费层级和直播功能；四是广播电台，通过Bell Media Radio分部运营加拿大最大的私营广播电台网络及iHeartRadio Canada平台；五是户外广告，通过Astral品牌运营全国数字和静态广告牌网络，2024年以4.1亿加元收购Outfront Media加拿大业务后进一步扩大规模。在总裁肖恩·科汉（Sean Cohan）领导下，贝尔传媒正加速数字化转型，推动加拿大内容国际化，通过收购Sphere Abacus多数股权、投资Blink49 Studios、与Tubi达成战略合作等举措，构建全球内容分发和制作网络。
apec_stance: 贝尔传媒作为加拿大最大的私营媒体集团，与APEC区域的联系主要体现在内容合作与跨境媒体贸易方面。公司积极推动加拿大原创内容走向亚太市场，通过'Northern Lights'计划寻求国际制作合作伙伴，并将加拿大电视剧（如'Transplant'、'Heated Rivalry'）分销至亚太地区。作为加拿大文化出口的重要参与者，贝尔传媒受益于加拿大与APEC经济体之间的自由贸易协定和文化产业政策，同时也受到《在线流媒体法案》（Bill C-11）和《在线新闻法案》（Bill C-18）等监管框架的影响，这些法规涉及国际流媒体平台在加拿大的运营义务。公司与ESPN（华特迪士尼旗下）、华纳兄弟探索等美国媒体巨头的合作关系也延伸至APEC区域的内容分销网络。
